name: OpenEgo
tagline: 1,107 h / 119.6M frames from 6 public ego datasets (258+ people, 600+ environments) unified to MANO-21 hand poses and action primitives.

annotations.coverageNote: Hand poses on all frames (camera frame, visibility-flagged); language primitives are auto-generated and only partially verified; EgoDex video not redistributed.

narrations.note: Timestamped free-text action primitives with objects and actors per demo

action_labels.note: Task string + action segments with start/end timestamps

hand_pose.note: 21-joint MANO poses in camera coords + per-joint visibility; 2D via intrinsics

object_pose.note: Not carried into the unified format (HOT3D / HO-Cap sources have it)

camera_pose.note: Extrinsics used to convert poses to camera frame; not in the shipped layout

samples.caption: Ego frames with 21-joint hand poses and action primitives for 'Assemble a GoPro camera' (paper figure)
